integrity: The sign classification has an all-parameter analytic proof based on conditional expectations and strict concavity; independently enumerated rational instances and symbolic identities support the computation. Historical priority is qualified by broader run-distribution and occupancy literature; no independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Requires symmetric positive Dirichlet parameters and unit reinforcement, and concerns exact-frequency and sequential switching covariance only; zero covariance is not independence.
title: Two covariance sign reversals between rare-colour frequencies and run changes in symmetric Pólya sampling
